title: Baguette Tennis Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
A straight line of light, in three colours. A tennis bracelet of rectangular baguettes set crosswise, side by side, each held at its corners by gold claws and closed with a gold box clasp. About 4 to 5mm wide: fine enough for every day, bright enough for evening. In clear Crystal, deep Ruby or Emerald.

STYLING TIP: Wear two colours together, ruby with crystal, for a stack that reads festive without trying.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Rectangular baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, the line approximately 4 to 5mm wide
  • Colours: Crystal, Ruby or Emerald
  • Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine gold claws
  • Closure: Box clasp with fold over safety
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
